item.title: Global Oil Supply Crippled As Gulf Attacks, Hormuz Blockade Send Prices Surging
item.description: A widening supply shock propelled crude oil 35% higher in a week, pushing prices above $90 a barrel, as the Strait of Hormuz closed, drone strikes crippled Saudi oilfields, and a wave of force majeure declarations rippled through global energy markets. This is the result of escalating tensions between the U.S and Iran.
